topic: 被动语态全程突破 (The Passive Voice: From Basics to Advanced)
teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：被动语态就像英语里的“变身术”！当动作的“承受者”（如小猫、作业、苹果）想要走到句首做主角，或者不需要/不知道谁是动作的执行者时，句子的谓语动词就要穿上“被动外套”。
2. 【公式与口诀】：被动语态核心公式：be + 动词过去分词 (V-ed/V3)。记忆口诀：“被动语态 be 动词，时态变化看 be 身；过去分词紧跟后，动作承受者做主人！”
3. 【避坑指南】：① 漏写 be 动词（如错写成 'The book written by me'，遗漏了was/is）；② 混淆过去式与过去分词（如把 eaten 错写成 ate）；③ 忽略主谓一致（不可数名词或复数主语对应的 be 动词形式错误）。
4. 【经典例句】：
- Primary: The homework is finished by Tom every day. (每天作业都被汤姆完成。)
- Middle School: A new bridge was built over the river last year. (去年这条河上建起了一座新桥。)
- High School: The problem must be solved before the meeting starts. (这个问题必须在会议开始前被解决。)

questions.question: English _______ by millions of people all over the world.
questions.explanation: 考查一般现在时的被动语态。主语 English 为不可数名词，且表示客观事实，谓语用 is spoken。

questions.question: The classroom _______ by the students every afternoon.
questions.explanation: 根据时间状语 every afternoon 可知用一般现在时，主语 The classroom 是动作承受者，故用 is cleaned。

questions.question: Yesterday, a beautiful picture _______ by Lucy in the park.
questions.explanation: 时间状语 Yesterday 提示用一般过去时，画是被画出来的，故用过去时的被动语态 was painted。

questions.question: These library books _______ tomorrow afternoon.
questions.explanation: 时间状语 tomorrow 提示一般将来时，书是被归还的，将来时被动语态结构为 will be + 过去分词。

questions.question: Milk _______ in the fridge to keep it fresh.
questions.explanation: 考查情态动词的被动语态。结构为“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”，keep 的过去分词是 kept。

questions.question: Many trees _______ in our school every spring.
questions.explanation: 时间状语 every spring 表示经常性动作用一般现在时，主语 Many trees 为复数，故用 are planted。

questions.question: The lost key _______ under the sofa ten minutes ago.
questions.explanation: ten minutes ago 提示一般过去时，主语 The lost key 是单数，使用 was found。

questions.question: Can this difficult math problem _______ by a primary student?
questions.explanation: 含有情态动词 can 的疑问句被动语态：Can + 主语 + be + 过去分词？

questions.question: A lot of rubbish _______ into the sea every year.
questions.explanation: rubbish 是不可数名词，谓语动词用单数 is，结合 every year 选择 is thrown。

questions.question: The delicious cake _______ by my mother last night.
questions.explanation: last night 提示一般过去时，主语 cake 动作承受者，用 was made。

questions.question: Interesting stories _______ to the kids by the teacher every Friday.
questions.explanation: stories 是复数，every Friday 表示一般现在时，故选 are read (read 的过去分词拼写不变，发音为 /red/)。

questions.question: The broken bike _______ by Dad yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: yesterday afternoon 提示一般过去时，结合单数主语 bike，使用 was repaired。

questions.question: Young drivers _______ to wear seat belts at all times.
questions.explanation: 表示常规规则用一般现在时，驾驶员被告知，用复数形式 are told。

questions.question: Your homework should _______ before you watch TV.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should 后接动词原形，被动语态为 should be finished。

questions.question: The song 'Happy Birthday' _______ in almost every country.
questions.explanation: 歌曲被演唱，用被动语态；sing 的过去分词是 sung，结合一般现在时选 is sung。

questions.question: A new high-speed railway line _______ in our province at present.
questions.explanation: 考查现在进行时的被动语态。根据 at present 可知正处于进行状态，结构为 is/are being + 过去分词。

questions.question: By the time we arrived at the cinema, all the tickets _______.
questions.explanation: 考查过去完成时的被动语态。By the time + 过去时，主句动作发生在“过去的过去”，用 had been + 过去分词。

questions.question: The sick child needs _______ to the hospital immediately.
questions.explanation: 考查 need 表示“需要被做”的用法：need doing（用主动表被动）与 need to be done 等价，故选 C。

questions.question: The thief was seen _______ into the bank by a pedestrian just now.
questions.explanation: 感官动词 see sb do sth 变为被动语态时，省略的 to 必须还原，即 be seen to do sth。

questions.question: The injured soldier was well _______ by the doctor in the clinic.
questions.explanation: 考查短语动词的被动语态。look after 作为固定短语，变被动时介词 after 不能漏掉。

questions.question: Great changes _______ in my hometown over the past ten years.
questions.explanation: 易错题！take place 为不及物动词短语，没有被动语态；结合 over the past ten years 用现在完成时主动形式。

questions.question: The car broke down on the highway and had to _______ to the garage.
questions.explanation: had to 后面加动词原形，车是被拖走的，故用不定式的被动语态 be towed。

questions.question: With all the work _______, we went out to have lunch together.
questions.explanation: 考查 with 复合结构。work 与 finish 之间是被动关系，故用过去分词 finished 做宾语补足语。

questions.question: It is reported that a new science museum _______ in our city next year.
questions.explanation: 表示按计划或安排将要被发生的动作，可用 is/are to be + 过去分词。

questions.question: Never before _______ such an inspiring speech delivered in public.
questions.explanation: 否定副词 Never 前置引导部分倒装句，完成时态结构为 Have + 主语 + 过去分词；后半句为过去分词短语作定语修饰 speech。

questions.question: The house _______ window was broken in the hurricane has been repaired.
questions.explanation: 考查定语从句。whose 在从句中充当定语，表示“房子的”窗户被打破（was broken 被动语态）。

questions.question: He spoke so quietly that his voice could hardly _______.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 could + 否定副词 hardly 后接原形 be + 过去分词 heard，表示“几乎不能被听见”。

questions.question: The missing child was reported _______ safe and sound in a neighboring town.
questions.explanation: be reported to have been done 表示“据报道已经被……”，不定式完成态被动语态表示动作发生在报道之前且是被动发生。

questions.question: The headmaster demanded that all rules _______ by the students without exception.
questions.explanation: demand 引导宾语从句用虚拟语气 (should) + 动词原形，规则是被遵循的，故用 (should) be followed，should 可省略。

questions.question: Having _______ twice, the young writer finally got his novel published.
questions.explanation: 考查分词完成态的被动形式。作状语的逻辑主语是 writer，writer 与 reject 是被动关系，且发生在谓语动词 got 之前，用 Having been + 过去分词。
